subject: Annual commit tiers & pricing proposal — Redwood Hosted API
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Bradshaw <emma.bradshaw@beacon-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-14T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Annual commit tiers & pricing proposal — Redwood Hosted API

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really appreciated the depth from your engineering team. Per our conversation about predictable unit economics, attached is a concise annual commit tier proposal for Beacon Analytics' expected Hosted API usage. I kept the options tight to make procurement easier. High level: Starter is for low-volume proofs, Growth is for teams scaling production usage, Enterprise provides the best unit economics plus SLA and dedicated support bandwidth.

Attachment: 20260214-Redwood-Commit-Tiers-v1.pdf (1 page; tables with token commits and per-token net pricing)

Proposal summary (annual committed tokens):
- Starter: 50M tokens/yr — list price $0.0015/token — 10% prepaid discount net $0.00135/token — monthly carryover up to 15%
- Growth: 400M tokens/yr — list price $0.0012/token — 18% prepaid discount net $0.000984/token — overage capped at 120% of committed unit price
- Enterprise: 2B tokens/yr — list price $0.0009/token — 28% prepaid discount net $0.000648/token — includes SLA (99.9%), priority capacity, and quarterly architecture reviews

Other terms:
- Overage: automatic billing at committed-tier overage price; option to buy monthly top-ups at negotiated rate for Growth/Enterprise.
- Ramp flexibility: we can front-load credits in Q1 for ramping pilots (subject to contract).
- Measurement: tokens = input + output tokens as measured by Redwood logs; access to token-level reports and monthly reconciliation.
- Billing: annual invoice with 30-day net; procurement documents accepted (PO + signed SOW).

Ask: can you share which commit band Beacon is leaning toward and whether finance prefers annual prepay or monthly invoicing against the commit? I can hop on a 30-min call with Marcus (sales engineering) and Laura (sales ops) if it helps accelerate approvals.

If you prefer, we can provide a 1-page redline-ready term sheet for legal to review — happy to coordinate.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: 20260214-Redwood-Commit-Tiers-v1.pdf
From: Emma Bradshaw <emma.bradshaw@beacon-analytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mike Lloyd <mike.lloyd@beacon-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Annual commit tiers & pricing proposal — Redwood Hosted API

Thanks Stephanie — and thanks for the clear options. A few quick questions from procurement and finance: 

1) Can you confirm the minimum term for Starter vs Growth vs Enterprise? Is Starter eligible for quarterly renewals or strictly annual?
2) For Enterprise — can we get an option for phased commitments (e.g., 500M first 6 months, remainder after Q3) instead of committing 2B up front?
3) Our procurement requires a PO process and vendor form. Is a DocuSign signature + annual PO acceptable?
4) Technical: we need to confirm data handling for PII tokens — do you have a SOC2 + encryption at rest statement we can share with security?

Also — will you accept the redlines we attached from our legal team (sent in a separate doc in this thread)? If not, what are the material points Redwood expects to hold firm on?

Best,
Emma
VP of Product Operations | Beacon Analytics
emma.bradshaw@beacon-analytics.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-16T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Beacon pricing Qs + redlines — need quick approvals

Internal — forwarding Beacon's questions and attached redlines (Beacon-Redlines-20260214.docx). TL;DR: they want flexibility on phased commits for Enterprise, confirmation on PO + DocuSign workflow, and SOC2 evidence.

What I need: 
- Marcus: pricing approval on a phased Enterprise approach (proposed concession below). Do we have precedent to price by effective committed run-rate?
- Laura: procurement operations — is DocuSign + annual PO combo acceptable? Any billing cadence constraints that would block acceptance of an annual prepay?
- Priyom: finance — can we offer the following concession without legal escalation? Proposed concession: allow phased Enterprise commit (minimum 500M tokens initial, remaining balance drawn within 12 months) with pro-rated discount such that the 500M initial tranche gets Growth-tier discount and the full 2B committed after full funding receives Enterprise discount retroactively for charges from the date of final commitment. Also, limit the retroactive credit to the difference up to first-year invoice amount.

If this sounds reasonable I will reply to Beacon confirming we can support phased commits, SOC2 artifact delivery, and PO+DocuSign for signature. I also propose we attach the 1-page term summary and the redlines doc for legal to triage.

Deal ID: HL-2026-BEACON-17 (HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HL-2026-BEACON-17)

Thanks — please mark with quick thumbs up / reply so I can respond today.

— Steph
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Bradshaw <emma.bradshaw@beacon-analytics.com>, Mike Lloyd <mike.lloyd@beacon-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Annual commit tiers & pricing proposal — Redwood Hosted API

Hi Emma / Mike — following internal confirmation, here are clear answers and a slightly refined proposal that should address Beacon's procurement and ramp needs. See inline below and a next step suggestion at the bottom.

1) Minimum term: Starter = 12 months (annual); Growth = 12 months (annual); Enterprise = 12 months (annual) with phased funding allowed (details below).

2) Phased Enterprise commits (concession): we can support a phased approach. Example for your requested pattern:
   - Phase A: 500M tokens initial (first 6 months) — charged at Growth-tier net price $0.000984/token.
   - Phase B: remaining 1.5B tokens deployed within the following 6 months and committed for the remainder of the 12-month term.
   - If Phase B is exercised and paid within the 12 months, we will retroactively apply the Enterprise-tier pricing difference (Enterprise net $0.000648/token) to tokens billed since the start of the contract up to the total committed amount, capped at the invoiced amount for year 1. Any retroactive credit will be processed via credit memo on your next invoice.

3) Billing/procurement: DocuSign signature + annual PO is acceptable. We accept annual prepay (preferred for discount) or annual invoice with 30-day net. Laura — our ops team will work directly with your procurement contact to ensure PO number mapping on invoices.

4) Security artifacts: Redwood can provide SOC 2 Type II report summary (redacted) and an encryption-at-rest statement. I will send these as an artifact bundle via our secure sharing link; if Beacon needs an executed NDA to share more sensitive evidence, we can accommodate that too.

5) Redlines: we reviewed Beacon-Redlines-20260214.docx. Material sticking points are limited to indemnity and data residency clauses. We are open to Beacon's edits on non-core clauses; for indemnity/data residency, we request a short call between legal teams. To avoid blocking procurement, we can proceed with a signed SOW and pay terms while legal triages the redlines.

Final proposed tranche pricing (repeat with final numbers):
- Starter (50M): $0.00135/token (10% net)
- Growth (400M): $0.000984/token (18% net)
- Enterprise (2B): $0.000648/token (28% net) — phased first tranche priced at Growth until full commit executed, with retro credits as described.

Next steps: If this matches Beacon's needs, I can share a 1-page term summary and a DocuSign link for signature, and loop Laura to capture PO info. Proposed meeting: 30 minutes on Tues 2/23 to finalize procurement flow — Marcus and Laura will join.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/sign?doc=HL-2026-BEACON-17

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to run through the ramp mechanics if useful.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

summary: Sales thread proposing annual commit tiers (Starter/Growth/Enterprise) for Beacon Analytics, customer asks about phased commits and procurement; Redwood agrees to phased Enterprise with retroactive pricing credit and confirms DocuSign + PO workflow and SOC2 artifact delivery.
